acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given I navigate to the Data Entry page When I click "Add Income Source" Then I see a form with fields: Income source (required, text), Monthly amount (required, ZAR currency input, min R0), Payment date (optional, day 1-31)
Given I fill out the form with valid data When I click "Save Income" Then the income entry is saved to Dexie database with createdAt timestamp
Given a successful save When the operation completes Then I see a success toast "Income source saved"
Given I add multiple income sources When I view the income section Then I see a list of all income sources with amounts (ZAR formatted)
Given I have multiple income entries When I view the income section Then I see total monthly income displayed at the bottom of the list
Given I click "Edit" on an income entry When the edit form opens Then the form is populated with existing data
Given I modify fields in edit mode and click "Save" When the save completes Then the income entry is updated in database and I see success toast "Income source updated"
Given I click "Delete" on an income entry When I see the confirmation dialog and confirm Then the entry is removed from database and I see success toast "Income source deleted"
Given I add, edit, or delete income entries When I view total income Then the total recalculates automatically (reactive via useLiveQuery)

constraints.constraint: All data persisted via Dexie.js to IndexedDB (ADR-002)
All monetary calculations use big.js for precision (ADR-003)
All forms use React Hook Form with Zod validation (ADR-006)
Follow existing hook pattern: useLiveQuery, CRUD ops returning Result type
Follow existing component pattern: Form, Card, List, Section hierarchy
Use toast.success() for success feedback, toast.error() for errors
Currency values stored as strings for big.js compatibility
Use DeleteConfirmDialog pattern for delete confirmation
All new code requires tests - validation, hooks, components
Files: kebab-case, Components: PascalCase, hooks: camelCase with use prefix

interface.name: IncomeEntry
interface.signature: interface IncomeEntry { id?: number; source: string; amount: string; paymentDate: number; createdAt: string; }

interface.name: UseIncomeReturn
interface.signature: interface UseIncomeReturn { incomeEntries: IncomeEntry[]; isLoading: boolean; addIncome: (income: Omit<IncomeEntry, 'id' | 'createdAt'>) => Promise<Result<number>>; updateIncome: (id: number, updates: Partial<IncomeEntry>) => Promise<Result<void>>; deleteIncome: (id: number) => Promise<Result<void>>; totalMonthlyIncome: string; }

interface.name: db.income
interface.signature: Table<IncomeEntry, number> with schema '++id, source, date'

interface.name: Result<T, E>
interface.signature: type Result<T, E = Error> = { success: true; data: T } | { success: false; error: E }

tests.standards: Vitest for unit and integration tests. React Testing Library for component tests. Tests co-located in tests/ directory mirroring src/ structure. Use fake-indexeddb/auto for Dexie tests. Follow existing test patterns from account and flexi-facility tests. Current test count: 317 passing tests.
